Tower on a Building: Class 10 board exam ka ye question dekh ke dar lagta hai? NCERT Ex 9.1 Q7, step by step, with the trap that costs marks.

• Draw it first: building BC = 20 m, tower CD = h, point P on the ground
• 45° gives PB = 20 m
• The trap: for 60°, the opposite side is BD = 20 + h, not h
• h = 20(√3 − 1) m ≈ 14.64 m
